verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no in-product natural-language command interface, AI assistant, or chat-based control. The official MCP server (bugsnag-probe-3, bugsnag-docs-21) lets external AI agents connect to BugSnag, but that belongs to the separate MCP-server story and does not transfer here. Slack actions and keyboard shortcuts are adjacent controls, not natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
